audit_summary.space_type: interior window bay / balcony access area

estimated_materials: PVC-U (polyvinyl chloride), tempered glass, aluminum reinforcement, EPDM seals

technical_features.labels_or_markings: no visible manufacturer labels or certification badges; window glass has decorative snowflake decals (non-structural)
technical_features.connection_type: hinged, surface-mounted to window frame with concealed hinge pins

salvageable_components.deconstruction_notes: Remove by disengaging locking mechanism, releasing hinges, and carefully lifting out. Check for sealant or mastic at frame-to-wall interface; may require gentle prying with flat bar. Glass panes are likely laminated or double-glazed—handle with care to avoid breakage.

salvageable_components.item_name: interior window sill (likely PVC or painted wood)

technical_features.connection_type: adhered or dry-fitted to window frame

salvageable_components.deconstruction_notes: Remove by gently prying from frame; may be glued with silicone or acrylic sealant. Clean and sand for refinishing if surface is intact.

salvageable_components.item_name: ceiling soffit with horizontal slats (likely PVC or painted wood)

technical_features.connection_type: screwed or nailed to ceiling joists

salvageable_components.deconstruction_notes: Remove by unscrewing or prying slats from backing; check for moisture damage or mold at joints.

hazard_and_diagnostic_flags: Verify presence of legacy sealants or adhesives at window frame-to-wall interface—may contain VOCs or formaldehyde; test if necessary.
Inspect window glass for laminated safety glazing (PVB interlayer) or low-emissivity coatings—may affect recycling value.
Check for hidden insulation or mastic behind window frame—potential for asbestos or CFC-based foams in older builds (though this unit appears modern).
